en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), the Couplets beginning with Grasping (Upādānaduka), etc.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive (*anidassana-appaṭigha*) and subject to clinging (*upādāna*), there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and is not subject to clinging, by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six;
under object condition (*ārammaṇa*) there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) there are six.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive and is a defilement (*kilesa*), there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and is not a defilement, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are six; in the object condition, three …pe… in the non-disappearance condition, six.
